notes: Wallpaper, round three - now with the answer in hand. Your Read trail showed SecurityException from every read path, and that is documented Android 14+ behavior: no regular app may read the wallpaper image anymore, so Kinto can only show it through the window. This build adds a layer test in Appearance > Background: tap 'Run layer test' and watch - the screen empties to a bare window, then the page returns, then the Lens. Note the first stage where your wallpaper is not visible, or if it never appears. The Native check line also now reports whether Kinto is your default home app. Nothing else changes.
